description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the ImageAttachmentController in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin. It contains setup routines and multiple test cases to verify the handling of different image attachments, such as client logos, banners, and login images, by asserting headers and content responses.

classes.name: ImageAttachmentControllerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImageAttachmentController, verifying image retrieval and response headers.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures by loading theme data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testClientLogo
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the client logo image and checks response headers and content length.

methods.name: testClientBanner
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the client banner image with header assertions.

methods.name: testLoginBanner
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the login banner image and verifies response details.

methods.name: testInvalidImageName
methods.description: Tests controller response to an invalid image name parameter, expecting a 400 error.
